content: Meditation is the discovery that the point of life is always arrived at in the immediate moment.
author: Alan Watts
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Loneliness is the painful ache of feeling incomplete, while solitude is the rich discovery of your own inner presence. In a world full of constant stimulation and notifications, being alone with your thoughts can feel intimidating.

Across his life and work, Alan Watts saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Yet silence is the only space where you can hear what your life is actually trying to say to you. When you make peace with quiet, you stop running to distractions to save you from yourself.
reflectionPrompt: What quiet yearning in your heart is asking for your attention and honest devotion?
